backend/main.mo: Defines core actor with hotel, homestay, booking, user, admin, partner, and notification types plus in‑memory maps and authentication helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature‑to‑file mappings and metadata for two implemented features with associated components and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app defining routing, providers, layout, and session timeout handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoomM: Provides an interface for admins to add, edit, validate, and delete room entries, including pricing, media, owner details, and availability. Loads rooms from storage and syncs updates via custom events.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingMan: Displays all customer bookings with status breakdown, expiration checks, and dynamic UI updates when bookings change. Pulls booking data from storage and renders detailed booking cards.
frontend/src/components/admin/HomeStayMa: Manages creation and editing of homestays, including room availability, pricing, amenities, and linked hotels. Syncs with storage and ensures roomAvailability matches roomCount.
frontend/src/components/admin/HotelManag: Provides CRUD management for hotels with fields for details, amenities, media, partner info, and admin overrides. Loads and saves hotel data while handling form population and validation.
frontend/src/components/admin/IssuesMana: Displays and manages reported issues, allowing status toggling and deletion. Loads issues from storage, sorts them by timestamp, and updates in response to events.
frontend/src/components/admin/Notificati: Displays and manages categorized notifications by syncing backend and local storage, allowing deletion and category toggling.
frontend/src/components/admin/PasscodeMa: Manages homestay passcodes with add and remove functionality, including validation and storage updates.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReportsExp: Generates PDF reports for bookings, customers, and properties using multiple filters and customized HTML formatting.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReviewMana: Loads, filters, displays, and deletes customer reviews with rating summaries and search capabilities.
frontend/src/components/admin/RoomManage: Empty placeholder file for room management functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/SMSNotific: Shows recent SMS notifications, status statistics, and auto-updates through events and polling.
frontend/src/components/admin/StripeSetu: Empty file reserved for future Stripe configuration UI.
frontend/src/components/admin/TempleSpec: Admin UI to add, edit, reorder, preview, and save temple update items including images, descriptions, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/AIChatWidget.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an AI chat widget component.
frontend/src/components/CustomerInfoModa: Modal prompting users to enter name and phone with validation and submit callback.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with navigation, customer/partner/admin auth handling, language selection, and theme toggle.
frontend/src/components/HelpFAQWidget.ts: Interactive FAQ widget with search, keyword filtering, and FAQ detail viewing, plus legacy chat-history cleanup.
frontend/src/components/LanguageProvider: Provides language context, persistence, and translation helper for the app.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App layout wrapper rendering header, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/OfflineIndicator: Shows online/offline status and handles pending local data sync when connection is restored.
frontend/src/components/partner/PayoutTr: Displays partner earnings, payout history, and allows requesting payouts based on confirmed bookings.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting new authenticated users to set their profile name and save it via API.
frontend/src/components/ReportIssueDialo: Dialog for reporting booking or service issues, storing them locally and generating notifications.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSection.ts: Displays homestay reviews, rating averages, and allows eligible users or admins to add or delete reviews.
frontend/src/components/TimeoutReviewPro: Prompts users after session timeout to leave a star rating and optional feedback stored as an issue.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
Tracks user activity and triggers a timeout callback with rate limiting after 30 minutes of inactivity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state and login/logout functions using Internet Identity, restoring and managing identities across reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useNotificationToasts: Listens for newNotification events and shows deduplicated toast alerts based on notification category.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating hotels, homestays, bookings, profiles, and other backend entities via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and a saffron-gold themed light/dark design system with CSS variables and utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/analytics.ts: Implements localStorage-based analytics tracking for visitors, bookings, revenue, and related events.
frontend/src/lib/dataStorage.ts: Provides schema, defaults, and versioned localStorage persistence for hotels, homestays, bookings, notifications, analytics, and temple specials.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines a lightweight multilingual translation system with language persistence and dictionaries for UI text.
frontend/src/lib/invoicePrint.ts: Generates printable HTML invoices for bookings with styled sections and print/PDF instructions.
frontend/src/lib/issueStorage.ts: Handles creation, loading, updating, and deletion of issue reports stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/notificationStorage.ts: Manages permanent admin notifications with localStorage storage, category filtering, and update events.
frontend/src/lib/reviewStorage.ts: Manages HomeStay reviews in localStorage, including CRUD operations, rating averages, and booking-based review eligibility.
frontend/src/lib/roomStorage.ts: Handles room data in localStorage with functions for CRUD, price and availability updates, passcodes, and search.
frontend/src/lib/smsNotifications.ts: Simulates SMS notifications, stores logs in localStorage, and provides filtering, cleanup, and statistics utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminAppPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page handling authentication, theme switching, and loading/updating hotel, homestay, notification, and analytics data.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/BookingConfirmationPa: Displays booking confirmation details by loading a booking from localStorage via bookingId.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form that validates customer session, loads HomeStay and hotel data, calculates availability, pricing, and submits bookings.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseRoomsPage.tsx: Displays searchable list of available homestays, handles customer session checks, and navigates to room details after optional customer info collection.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerLoginPage.tsx: Manages Internet Identity login and collects customer's name on first login before navigating to browse rooms.
frontend/src/pages/DownloadCenterPage.ts: Static page presenting project resources, structure, and setup instructions with download options.
frontend/src/pages/DownloadProjectPage.t: Empty page placeholder with no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showing temple specials, rotating updates, landmarks, and navigation actions based on authentication.
frontend/src/pages/MyBookingsPage.tsx: Shows user's bookings, supports cancellation, invoice printing, and listens for booking updates.
frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx: Renders a notifications dashboard, loading and displaying stored notifications with category counts and icons.
Shows partner homestay details, bookings, revenue stats, and allows price and room availability updates with live data refresh.
frontend/src/pages/PartnerLoginPage.tsx: Handles partner login via passcode lookup, storing auth state and navigating to the dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Empty placeholder page for failed payment handling.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Empty placeholder page for successful payment handling.
frontend/src/pages/RoomDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed homestay info with media, stats, and booking flow validation before navigating to booking.
frontend/src/pages/RoomSearchPage.tsx: Empty placeholder page for room search functionality.
frontend/src/pages/StandaloneRoomSearchP: Empty placeholder page for a standalone room search screen.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, container settings, animations, and extended theme options for UI styling. Imports typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, existing features, and pending feature requests related to issue reporting and admin booking visibility.
